publisher: Central Statistics Office (Ireland), from matched BER and Gas Networks Ireland meter data
title: Mean Gas Consumption by type of dwelling, energy rating and year (DBERNG01)
used_for: The heating-side D24 target, and the one the estate actually needs: 49 of its 50 homes heat with gas, so their space heat never appears in the electricity meter and DBEREL01 cannot see it. In a gas-heated dwelling, gas consumption IS space heating plus hot water, which makes this the direct check on the F1 physics and the heating schedule - the largest energy term in the model and, until now, the one with no public target at all. Same axes as DBEREL01 (dwelling type x BER band), so the two can be read together per dwelling. Exposure is 'tuning' because the floor-area and room-allocation fixes in I-031 were checked against it, and from week 3 the fabric is derived from the BER Research Tool whose own validation runs through this axis. So PL-GAS-01, which scores against this table, is a CONSISTENCY check against a calibration input and NOT an independent validation - the held-out gas axis is DBERNG02 (dwelling type x period of construction), exposure 'none', which is what U31 uses. See I-058.
